name: defensiveness
quote: I don't think I'm the only one.
description: Anxiety from a perceived threat that triggers a reaction seen by others as unnecessarily vigorous.

variations.name: physical defensiveness
variations.description: If the perceived threat is physical, the response may be to overestimate the threat and adopt a posture more defensive than required.

variations.name: social defensiveness
variations.description: If the perceived threat is against your ego or social status, the response may be to avoid responsibility with a verbal explanation or justification.

variations.name: gaslight defensiveness
variations.description: If your reaction was an appropriate response causing the other to back down, they may accuse you of 'defensiveness' as a way of shifting blame.

variations.name: realized defensiveness
variations.description: If you recognize that you've been pushing away valid feedback, you may experience embarassment or humility.

commentaries.quote: People mostly apply the 'defensive' label to others. From inside the experience, the reaction often feels like a warranted act of self-protection.

It's sometimes difficult from the inside to accurately judge the severity of a threat. It's fair to defend yourself, but it's the manner of the defense against a minor threat that can be critiqued by others as being 'defensive'.
It takes a good deal of strength to face a threat calmly.

conditions: The self's social standing is perceived as being threatened and you have to take action.
Social judgment that your action is more than necessary.
The body is perceived as being threatened and that you have to take action.
Social judgment that your action is more than necessary.
